# Moses Mastery

> Moses Mastery is a Shopify and eCommerce growth studio founded by Moses Daniel. It designs, builds and grows Shopify stores: store design and development, conversion rate optimization (CRO), Meta and Google Ads, eCommerce SEO, brand design and AI automation for online stores.

Website: https://mosesmastery.com/
Contact: info@mosesecom.com, +1 (581) 809-5630, https://mosesmastery.com/contact.html
Social: https://www.instagram.com/moses__mastery, https://x.com/moses_mastery, https://pin.it/7k7AHvYYQ, https://t.me/moses_mastery

## Main pages
- [Home](https://mosesmastery.com/): services, packages and FAQ
- [Projects](https://mosesmastery.com/projects.html): Shopify stores, analytics dashboards and screen recordings
- [Contact](https://mosesmastery.com/contact.html): book a strategy call or request a quote
- [Blog](https://mosesmastery.com/blog/): practical Shopify, CRO, SEO, ads and AI guides

## Services
- Shopify store design and development, theme customization and redesigns
- Conversion rate optimization (CRO) and store audits
- Meta Ads and Google Ads management
- eCommerce SEO and Google Merchant Center
- AI automation, AI content and creative, AI chatbots and assistants

## Pricing (starting points, quoted per project)
- Store Launch packages (one-time): Starter from $500, Growth from $950, Premium from $1,500
- Growth Marketing packages (monthly, ad spend not included): Launch from $2,000, Accelerate from $6,000, Elite from $10,500
